events.snippet: Run‐off manager’s report Premia Syndicate 1884 3 Reinsurance to close premium The reinsurance to close (“RITC”) premium of £64.4m paid to close the 2018 YOA is calculated as:  £58.6m in respect of best estimate net insurance liabilities  £5.8m additional risk premium payable to the reinsuring year of accoun
The Board considered a number of specific tests and analyses in order to establish whether the RITC premium represented an equitable outcome for both reinsured and reinsuring capital providers.
• Independent external analyses of best estimate liabilities supported and were consistent with internal management estimates used to calculate the RITC premium.
• The RITC premium provided an appropriate degree of risk transfer to the reinsuring 2021 YOA.

Based on the results of these analyses the Board has satisfied itself that the RITC premium charged to the 2018 YOA is reasonable and provides an equitable outcome for both reinsured and reinsuring capital providers.
In addition to the RITC of the 2018 YOA, the Syndicate has also completed two additional RITC transactions of the 2018 YOA of syndicate 1955 and the 2018 YOA of syndicate 1861.

As an integral part of the Premia group, the Syndicate will seek out new opportunities to add to the portfolio of risks under management through RITC or legacy reinsurance transactions in 2021, subject to completion of thorough due diligence and pricing being sufficient to meet return on capital objectives.
Subsequent events On 1st January 2021, the 2018 and prior years of account was closed by a Reinsurance to close agreement (RITC) into the 2021 year of account.
